question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Comparison between things that have similar features
solution:
The correct answer is **'Analogy'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Comparison** between things that have **similar features** is said to be as '**Analogy'**. 

 
 
• For eg:-we can make an analogy between the human body and a car engine.
 
 

So, the correct **one-word substitute** for the sentence is **analogy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

let's look at the other options,

 
• **Resemblance** means the fact that **two people** or **things** look **like each other** or are** similar** in **some other way**.
 
• **Contrast** means comparison between **two people** or **things** that shows the **differences between them.**
 
• **Description** :- an act of **describing; **specifically to** say** what **somebody/something** is like, or what happened.
